Cao Yu is a Chinese cinematographer known for his work in contemporary Chinese cinema. He has gained recognition for his visual style and has collaborated on several notable films. Some key points about Cao Yu include:

- He graduated from the Beijing Film Academy, which is one of the top film schools in China.
- Cao Yu is known for his ability to create atmospheric and visually compelling imagery, often contributing to the mood and tone of the films he shoots.
- He worked as the director of photography on several acclaimed Chinese movies.
- His work includes films like "See You Tomorrow" (2016), "So Long, My Son" (2019), and "Ash Is Purest White" (2018), among others.
- "So Long, My Son," directed by Wang Xiaoshuai, received critical acclaim, and Cao Yu’s cinematography was praised for its emotional depth and realistic portrayal of China’s social changes.
- He has been recognized within China’s film industry and continues to be a prominent figure in cinematic cinematography.
